params.name: data
params.description: Optional. Data for populating the Message object.

params.name: data.results
params.description: A list of recommended products. The order represents the ranking (from the most relevant product to the least).

params.name: data.attribution_token
params.description: A unique attribution token. This should be included in the [UserEvent][google.cloud.retail.v2.UserEvent] logs resulting from this recommendation, which enables accurate attribution of recommendation model performance.

params.name: data.missing_ids
params.description: IDs of products in the request that were missing from the inventory.

params.name: data.validate_only
params.description: True if the validateOnly property was set in the request.
